description:
A false-colour infrared aerial image shows an urban or peri-urban landscape with various land cover types delineated by polygons and identified by four-digit numeric codes. The underlying imagery displays healthy vegetation in shades of bright red, while built-up or bare areas appear in grey-blue tones.

Three distinct land cover areas are labelled:
*   A large, irregularly shaped central polygon outlined in cyan is labelled "1400" in pink text. This area shows intense red hues, characteristic of dense, healthy vegetation, likely representing sports or leisure facilities, or a green urban area.
*   Towards the bottom left, an area is labelled "1210" in green text, within a less distinct green outline. This area appears to be a mix of grey-blue and some red, suggesting industrial, commercial, or other complex artificial units.
*   Towards the bottom right, an area is labelled "1110" in green text, also within a less distinct green outline. This area primarily shows grey-blue tones, indicating continuous urban fabric or densely built-up areas.

No scale bar, compass, or specific geographic location is visible on the map. The numerical codes represent land cover classification categories within a nomenclature system.
